description: Prepends a copyright line to the hand-written js modules in a library tree while vendored code and a generated minified bundle stay unchanged. DISTILL-CANARY-82209e9a

files.lib/README.md:
# lib

Every hand-written .js file starts with the company copyright line.
lib/vendor/ is third-party code with its own licence header: do not touch it.
app.min.js is generated by the build, which adds its own header.

turns.prompt: Add the line `// Copyright (c) 2026 Acme Corp` as the very first line of every .js file under lib. lib/README.md says which files to skip. Check the result and reply DONE.
